requirement: v3.4.8: restore is plan-then-apply and must pass session-doctor, the G2 registry protocol and the G5 runtime verdict before writing; unlock opens the repository (machine/password) without disclosing the data key; archive produces a .tar.zst with a verified manifest and can itself be restored; verify checks every snapshot block, digest and index in both directions.

assertions.restore: plan classifies new/identical/differs; apply refuses on static reject, registry uncertainty or runtime reject; pre-restore copies kept and pruned by keep_pre_restore; target re-check refuses a changed file (BACKUP_RESTORE_TARGET_CHANGED)
assertions.registry: one registry document is planned and written atomically with read-back verification; the recheck replays a client overwrite
assertions.unlock: describe/unlock report available paths; the password path never echoes a secret; the DEK is not returned by the CLI
assertions.archive: tar.zst written with manifest + README; extract refuses path escape; restore --archive applies the same gates as repository restore
assertions.verify: all blocks decrypt and re-hash, index<->snapshot both directions checked, old records rebuilt, future-append simulated (static and, with --runtime, by the installed Harness)
assertions.runtime: the installed Harness validates original + appended logs through sessionFormatCatalog.createRestore(..., validation:'current')
